svg.text: 4 — The buyer stops at the service between start and disclosure
authorize disclose → snapshot shows stop at t
decision: physical end = t (verified end); disclosure refused
journal: target = periods starting ≥ t; reverse pending
stop already present (payer) → acknowledged; fact: financial complete
No disclosure after a committed end; teardown; the charge runs from start to the stop only
